questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

As increasing dependence on information systems develop (1)/ the need for such systems (2)/ to be reliable and secure also becomes more essential. (3)/ No error (4).
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Here, concept of subject - verb agreement is brought under consideration. Since, subject **increasing dependence **is a 3rd person singular noun. Hence, the verb used should also be singular. Hence, replace **develop **with **develops. **So, option 1 is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **As increasing dependence on information systems develops the need for such systems to be reliable and secure also becomes more essential.

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

Like most combat ofﬁcers who had seen their men die (1)/ and occasionally buried the hideously (2)/ mutilated bodies of those unlucky enough to taken alive. (3)/ No error (4).
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

Here, concept of to + infinitive is brought under consideration. The to-infinitive i.e. to + V1 is used in many sentence constructions, often expressing the purpose of something or someone's opinion about something. So, replace **taken **with **take. **Thus, option 3 is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **Like most combat ofﬁcers who had seen their men die and occasionally buried the hideously mutilated bodies of those unlucky enough to take alive.

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be ﬁlled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

Four braces of partridges ______ been bought.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Here, concept of passive voice is brought under consideration. Sometimes, subject is not mentioned in the passive voice, thus use of **by **is also omitted. Since, blank is followed by **been **which is used with forms of 'have'. That is, 

Object + has/have + been + Verb's 3rd form.

So, options 3 & 4 are eliminated. Since, object is **four braces **which is a plural noun. Hence, plural verb to be used. So, option 2 is eliminated. Thus, option 1 i.e. **have **is the correct answer. 

**Correct sentence - **Four braces of partridges have been bought.

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be ﬁlled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

She ______ of going to Paris.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Here, concept of simple present tense is brought under consideration. Thus, option 4 is eliminated. When, 'he, she, it or 3rd personal singular is used as a subject. So, s/es is used with the main verb. Thus, option 1 is eliminated. Now, with reference to the context, she wants to go to Paris. And, the most appropriate word that fits the blank is **dreams. **Hence, option 3 is omitted. Thus, option 2 i.e. **dreams **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **She dreams of going to Paris.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which best expresses the meaning of the given word.**

NOVEL
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Firstly, let's find out the meaning of given word 'novel' :- Something of new kind; different from anything seen or known before; unique.

Whereas, words like 'common, usual & overused' means something which is general or widespread. Hence, word **unique **best expresses the meaning of the given word 'novel'. So, option 1 i.e. **unique **is the correct answer.

questions.question:

questions.question:

WILY
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Firstly, let's find out the meaning of given word 'wily' :- Creative; crafty; full of art.

Now, find the meaning of options :-

Artful - Full of art and creativity.

Ingenuous - Free from reserve, restraint; candid; artless; innocent; naive.

Thus, the word **artful **best describes the meaning of given word 'wily'. Hence, option 2 i.e. **artful **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which is opposite in meaning of the given word.**

JOLLY
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

The meaning of given word 'jolly' :- Happy; cheerful; fun loving; joyful; gay; merry, etc.

Whereas, 'serious' means not happy; sad; having deep thoughts. Thus, it is opposite in meaning to 'jolly'. So, option 1 i.e. **serious **is the correct answer.

questions.question:

questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

The correct meaning of above mentioned phrase is mildly ill; suffering from hangout. Hence, option 1 i.e. **not well **best expresses the meaning of given phrase.

**For example - **We were out celebrating Victor's birthday last night—that's why we're all under the weather today.

questions.question:

The correct meaning of above mentioned phrase is a cry or signal used on board ship, typically in an emergency, to indicate that all crew members are to go on deck. Hence, the alternative which best expresses the meaning of given idiom/phrase is option 1. Thus, option 1 is the correct answer.

**For example - **Your grandmother arrives tomorrow and the house is still a mess I need all hands on deck to help me clean! All hands on deck!

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

Delinquency is a

P: the course of normal social life

Q: kind of normality when

R: an individual deviates from
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Since, the starter of the passage ends with an article **a**, thus it cannot be followed by an article **the **again. Hence, options 1 & 3 are eliminated. Now, the sentence cannot end with a preposition **from. **Hence, option 4 is eliminated. Thus, option 2 i.e. **QRP **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **Delinquency is a kind of normality when an individual deviates from the course of normal social life.

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

Child malnutrition is the

P: the economy is said to be surging ahead

Q: is facing today even when

R: biggest challenge that our country
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Clearly, the starter of the passage ends with an article **the, **hence, it will not be followed by itself. So, option 1 is eliminated. Also, starter has verb** is, **thus it cannot be followed by verb directly. So, options 1 & 4 are eliminated. Thus, option 1 i.e. **RQP **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **Child malnutrition is the biggest challenge that our country is facing today even when the economy is said to be surging ahead.

questions.question: etiquette no ______ matters, that
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

On looking at the passage, we observe that it is based on importance of etiquette and good behaviour in maintaining peace and harmony among people. Since, the passage starts with a negative approach that in today's time, some people argue that etiquette is not important. So, to show the time, we will use the adverb **longer**. Hence, option 1 i.e. **longer **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **Some people argue that etiquette no longer matters, that the rules for good behaviour are old-fashioned and out of date.

questions.question: society would show ______ too much
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

With reference to the context, if there had no etiquette in the society, people would show a lot of impatience and violence. Since, a lot or very much cannot be determined by word like **near **or **close. **Thus, options 1 & 4 are eliminated. Whereas, **distance **is used as a noun or verb. But not adjective, thus option 2 is eliminated. Hence, option 3 i.e. **far **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **Without etiquette, members of society would show far too much impatience.
